sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Wind Release, Fire Release

system.description:
You compress your super-heated chakra into a sphere the size of a basketball that you then launch onto a space you can see within range, before, you cause it to expand into a cage of flame that then collapses back onto those in range. Select a space you can see in range, as the cage forms in a 15-foot cube originating on this space before you clap your hands collapsing it forcing all creatures in the affected area to make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 4d8 fire damage, and gaining 1 rank of Burned on a failure.

Scorch. By spending 2 Scorch Charges, you solidify the chakra making this cage, forcing creature who failed their saving throw to be Restrained in place by the flaming cage. This jutsu’s duration becomes Concentration, up to 1 minute and creatures that begin their turn restrained, takes 3d8 fire damage. A restrained creature make a Strength saving throw at the beginning of each of their turns to end this effect on them.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3, and the size of the cube by 5 feet.
